declarations.name: AuiSplitter

inputs.name: panes
inputs.description: Two to ten panes: { content: Node, label, size?, min?, max?, collapsible?, collapsed? }; lengths in px (number or '240px') or '%'.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: horizontal: panes side by side (vertical separators); vertical: stacked panes.

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Pixels a separator moves per arrow key press.

models.name: sizes
models.description: Restored sizes in percent per pane (from aui-change); overrides the panes' size.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user resized, collapsed, expanded, or reset: { sizes, collapsed, index, reason }; persist sizes and pass them back as sizes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Back to the initial sizes and collapsed states (no event).

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Window Splitter (variable): each separator is a focusable role=separator whose value is the size of the pane before it in percent; arrow keys move it, Home and End go to the limits, Enter collapses and restores.

limitations: A separator moves only its two neighboring panes.
The separator is 12px thick by default (splitter-size); its target spans the whole pane length.
Sizes are percentages of the space between separators; pixel sizes in panes[].size apply to the first layout only.
